end_rewards_completed.meaning: endRewards() executes to completion without reverting

assumptions: The pair address predicted by pairFor() is used by endRewards() to interact with the pair contract.
The actual pair contract is the one created by createPair() in GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the salt hashing formula or exact inputs, so the equality between pairFor()'s predicted address and createPair()'s actual address cannot be expressed as a numeric/address relation; only the completion obligation is formalized.
Report does not state who triggers totalFeeShare becoming zero or who calls endRewards().

limitations: The address-correspondence aspect of the intent is not encoded as an address equality; only the liveness obligation that endRewards() completes is formalized.
The concrete pair address values are symbolic and not bound to code.
